The tag alone cannot distinguish between a colocation facility serving external customers and internal office IT infrastructure operated by a software or hardware reseller. WinEuropa's name, combining a Windows reference with a geographic marker, aligns with regional IT sales and support patterns rather than data-center operation at scale. This matters because misclassified facilities distort maps of actual compute capacity, particularly in regions where data-center density is sparse and disambiguation is costly.
